summary: Master industrial robotics and automation strategy with OEE, ISO 10218, PLC integration, and robot cell planning. Enrol for practical 5-day training.
lede: Industrial robotics strategy helps manufacturing professionals assess automation opportunities and plan robot-cell deployments. Learners practice OEE analysis, robot-cell layout design, PLC integration mapping and safety assessment, then develop commissioning test plans and a rollout roadmap tied to production needs and report output, scrap and downtime KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already operate in manufacturing, automation, or production support and need to make better robotics decisions. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for robot deployment, line performance, safety controls, or the business case for automation.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop for workshop templates and simple spreadsheet exercises. Familiarity with production data, basic process diagrams, and factory-floor terminology will help you move quickly through the applied exercises.
